bsi.editorial_reason: Ezra 4:9 contains the Aramaic plural dinaye, interpreted as an ethnonym (Dinaites) or as a plural title (judges) in major translation/lexical witnesses. Either interpretation denotes multiple people rather than one male individual. This corrects only the semantic type to a collective group, without deciding between ethnonym and office or changing the original Aramaic word witness.
